subject: SOC2 attestation: ephemeral log retention carveout & burst capacity proposal
messages:
From: Helen Park <helen.park@novuscorp.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Log retention carveout and capacity increase request

Hi Olga / Kimberly,

We're approaching our Novus renewal and the SOC 2 attestation questions surfaced a gap: we have a stream of ephemeral debug logs that are large (spike during heavy ingest) and we can't retain them for the standard 365d window without a material cost jump. Our security team is proposing a carveout: full retention (raw logs) for 90 days for indices A/B, aggregated/metrics-only for 30 days for ephemeral traces, and rolling 180-day compressed indexes for transaction metadata.

Two asks: 1) Can Redwood accept a carveout and document it in the attestation/renewal addendum? 2) We expect peak load next quarter and would like a temporary burst capacity (equivalent to +2k rps sustained for 6 weeks) — can you map the cost impact?

We need a go/no-go by end of August so our procurement and audit teams can finalize the renewal paperwork.

Thanks,
Helen
Helen Park
Sr. Security Program Manager, Novus Corp

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@novuscorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-06T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Log retention carveout and capacity increase request
Attachments: proposed_carveout_matrix.xlsx (attachment stub: spreadsheet)

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear ask. We can work with a scoped carveout for the renewal provided we map controls and preserve the SOC 2 audit trail for scoped data. High-level proposal: 

- Scope: Indices A/B (raw) retained 90 days; ephemeral traces -> aggregated metrics 30 days; transaction metadata compressed 180 days.
- Controls: Enable prefix-based KV tagging so we can separate "ephemeral" vs "transactional" logs for ACL and audit export.
- Evidence: We will deliver a control mapping matrix (attached) + export plan (S3 staging) for auditor access.
- Timeline: sign amendment by 2027-09-15; evidence window staging start 2027-09-20; re-attestation materials delivered 2027-10-04.
- Capacity: We can provision a temporary burst pool (3-month window) sized for +2k rps; estimated incremental cost shown on sheet (row: burst-pricing).

Open items: a) confirmation on encryption at rest policy for the S3 handoff, b) whether Novus requires HSM-backed key custody for the exported bundle, and c) exact billing account to route the seat uplift.

I'm looping our product/legal lead Marissa and our contracts lead Kimberly to align wording. If that timeline works I'll draft the amendment language and a doc to send to your procurement team (DocuSign-ready).

Best,
Olga
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Helen Park <helen.park@novuscorp.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novuscorp.com, security@novuscorp.com
Date: 2027-08-07T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Log retention carveout and capacity increase request
Attachments: S3_handoff_specs.pdf (attachment stub: spec)

On Fri, Aug 6, 2027 at 11:32 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Helen — thanks for the clear ask. We can work with a scoped carveout for the renewal provided we map controls and preserve the SOC 2 audit trail for scoped data.

Thanks — that aligns with what our audit team suggested. A few clarifications: 

- We require the exported bundle to be encrypted client-side before it lands in your S3 staging bucket (we prefer vendor-side encryption plus SSE-KMS on the bucket).
- For HSM: we do not require HSM right now, standard KMS is acceptable for this carveout.
- Procurement: we can accept a 3-month seat uplift as a short-term addendum then roll to normal committed seats post-burst.

Please prepare the amendment language and include a detailed evidence transfer spec (I've attached the S3 handoff doc). We can route the DocuSign from procurement once Redwood confirms final wording and estimated uplift charge.

— Helen

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@novuscorp.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Log retention carveout and capacity increase request
Attachments: retention_addendum_snippet.docx (attachment stub: docx)

Hi Helen / Olga — quick legal/product note to make the amendment auditable and compatible with SOC 2: 

1) Carveout language (suggested snippet attached): we recommend describing the carveout as a "Scoped Retention Variation" tied to specific index prefixes and data types. This avoids open-ended wording.
2) Audit access: Redwood will provide a time-bound, read-only export to Novus' S3 staging bucket; Redwood will also publish a verification hash manifest signed by our platform key so auditors can validate integrity.
3) Retention guarantee: Please confirm that Novus accepts a governed "compressed retention" step (30d aggregated; 90d raw for indices A/B; 180d for meta) in exchange for the amendment. That acceptance needs to be recorded in procurement's signed addendum.
4) Pricing: Marissa, can you confirm the billing code for a 3-month burst and seat uplift?

If you confirm (3) we will prep the DocuSign-ready amendment and include the control-mapping appendix for the auditor.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Helen — thanks for the quick confirms. Summary and next steps (actionable):

- Agreed carveout: indices A/B raw 90d; ephemeral traces -> aggregated metrics 30d; metadata compressed 180d. Scope limited to prefixes: /novus/ingest/trace/* and /novus/ingest/trans/* (we will tag these).
- Evidence transfer: Redwood to push integrity-signed export to Novus S3 staging on 2027-09-20; Novus to confirm receipt and manifest verification by 2027-09-22. Export will be client-encrypted with SSE-KMS on the bucket as requested.
- Capacity: Provision burst pool from 2027-09-15 to 2027-12-15 sized for +2k rps; Billing: temporary uplift code "BURST-3M-HS32419" — Marissa will attach final numbers in the invoice addendum.
- Contract: DocuSign amendment will be sent to procurement once procurement confirms billing account and signs off on the "Scoped Retention Variation" wording. Kimberly, attached is the proposed snippet; please finalize the DocuSign body.
